# qrcodegen

QR Code generator library (C++) by Project Nayuki, MIT License (in the
headers of both files).

- Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator, tag `v1.8.0`, files
  `cpp/qrcodegen.cpp` and `cpp/qrcodegen.hpp`, unchanged.
- Used for the QR code of "Photo of the setup" (`ui/qrcodeimage.*`), the
  link a phone opens to send photos (`service/photoserver.*`).
